book_title: Prologue: The Business, The Refresh & Our Independent Verdict

epigraph.quote: Separate the strength of a Stage 2 chart from the unpriced friction of four regulatory overhangs; protect held shares with a rising stop and demand asymmetry for new money.
epigraph.author: Dossier Underwriting Charter

web_blocks.html: Business Reality & Nov 2026 Refresh: Aurobindo Pharma (NSE:AUROPHARMA) runs global generics, API, Pen-G, sterile injectable, and biologics plants [1]. FY26 sales reached ₹33,653 crore, and Q2 FY27 hit a record ₹10,263 crore (+23.9% YoY; Europe +27%) [1][3]. Ten-year CFO-to-PAT conversion is 113% with ₹3,002 crore in net cash [1][2]. In November 2026, API unit Apitoria earned clean USFDA VAI EIRs at Units II and VI [31][32]. Yet our refresh found four major drags. First, four formulation plants now sit in USFDA OAI or Warning Letter status: Eugia Units I, II, III and newly acquired Lannett Seymour, Indiana [8][9][32]. Second, the $245.7M Lannett deal added ₹460.27 Cr in goodwill [33]. Third, Kakinada Pen-G faces a Jan 2027 MIP cliff alongside US Section 232 tariff risk [34][35]. Fourth, MDL 2724 US antitrust suits stay unresolved [36]. Quality stays CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH).

web_blocks.title: Why New Capital Stays Rejected Despite a Cleaner Stage 2 VCP Chart
paragraphs: Technically, the chart tightened into a Stage 2 VCP squeeze (BB width 13.73%, RSI 66.49) after Apitoria's Nov 21 VAI EIR [23][31]. That supports holding our 0.63% Zerodha stake and lifting our stop from ₹1,585.12 to ₹1,599.40.

Fundamentally, Pass 1 trimmed FY28E Base EPS to ₹78.70 and fair value to ₹1,850.00 on four FDA backlogs, Pen-G's Jan 2027 MIP cliff, and MDL 2724 risk [32][33][34][36]. With 0.03:1 R/R at CMP and 0.66:1 at support, fresh cash fails our 1.50:1 gate.

web_blocks.html: How the Four Engines Fit Together: US Formulations (42.8% of FY26 sales, now aided by Lannett) and Europe (30.7%, +27% YoY) anchor revenue [2][3][33]. Meanwhile, Kakinada Pen-G, CuraTeQ biosimilars, and TheraNym CDMO are shifting from buildout to revenue [10][11][17]. This dossier tests whether those engines lift 12.9% ROCE past 16% despite four FDA backlogs [1][32].

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our November 2026 refreshed institutional dossier on Aurobindo Pharma Limited. Over the next nine chapters, we walk through forty years of industrial chemistry, global generic expansion, a ₹17,000-crore capital-allocation cycle, and four critical blind spots uncovered during our Pass 1 forensic audit.

Let's put the punchline right up front with full timestamp transparency. On the November 23, 2026 NSE session ledger, Aurobindo closed at ₹1,796.50. On the November 25, 2026 live TradingView snapshot, shares rallied +2.59% to ₹1,843.00—up +54.61% over the past twelve months and within 0.91% of their ₹1,859.90 52-week high. At ₹1,843.00, the stock trades at 26.1 times Screener trailing earnings (26.72 times TradingView) and roughly 15.0 times FY26 EBITDA.

Both sides of the Aurobindo story are real, and neither can be wished away. On the positive side, Aurobindo delivered a record ₹10,263 crore quarter in Q2 FY27 (+23.9% YoY), led by Europe Formulations surging +27% YoY to ₹3,161 crore (€288 million), while sustaining a 21.0% EBITDA margin, 113% ten-year CFO-to-PAT conversion, and ₹3,002 crore in net cash. Even better, API subsidiary Apitoria Pharma cleared back-to-back USFDA Establishment Inspection Reports with VAI status at Unit-II on November 11 and Unit-VI on November 21, 2026.

Yet our price-blind Pass 1 audit surfaced four material headwinds that prevent an unconditional compounder label and cap near-term valuation. First, Aurobindo's USFDA formulation backlog has widened from two sterile sites to four: Eugia Unit III, Eugia Unit II Bhiwadi, Eugia Unit I, and newly acquired Lannett Company LLC in Seymour, Indiana, which received OAI status on November 11. Second, Q2 FY27's US revenue surge was not purely organic—it was aided by the June 29, 2026 $245.7 million cash acquisition of Lannett, which added ₹460.27 crore in provisional goodwill now exposed to impairment risk if Seymour's OAI lingers.

Third, Kakinada Penicillin-G's EBITDA turnaround leaned on India's January 29, 2026 DGFT Minimum Import Price floor (₹2,216/kg Pen-G), which expires in January 2027—forcing subsidiary Lyfius Pharma to petition India's DGTR for anti-dumping duties (Case AD/OI/057/2026) against Chinese dumping, alongside US Section 232 generic tariff review risk. Fourth, Aurobindo Pharma USA remains a non-settling defendant in multistate US generic price-fixing antitrust litigation (MDL No. 2724), where peers settled heavily across 2026 including Sandoz ($400 million) and Glenmark ($29.6 million).

Factoring in post-Lannett depreciation (₹2,200 crore) and audited 31% tax trims our FY28E normalized Base EPS to ₹78.70. At a blended 23.5-times multiple, our Base Fair Value is ₹1,850.00—and our probability-weighted expected value across Bull (25% at ₹2,350.00), Base (50% at ₹1,850.00), and Bear (25% at ₹1,296.00) is ₹1,836.50, or -0.35% below live TradingView CMP. Against our ratcheted ₹1,599.40 structural stop, buying fresh shares at ₹1,843.00 yields just 0.03-to-1 reward-to-risk, and even a pullback to ₹1,718.52–₹1,750.00 yields only 0.66-to-1 at ₹1,750.00. Because neither level clears our 1.50-to-1 gate, our new-capital verdict is strictly REJECTED on VALUATION.

Meanwhile, for the 15 shares already held in your Zerodha account—costing ₹27,157.70 (₹1,810.51/share), valued at ₹26,947.50 (-0.77%, 0.63% weight) on the November 23 NSE ledger and ₹27,645.00 (+1.79%) on the November 25 live TradingView mark—our holding action is HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP. Because the primary Stage 2 uptrend tightened into a healthy VCP squeeze (+13.78% above the rising 30-week SMA at ₹1,619.75), we sell zero shares today and ratchet our hard closing stop upward from ₹1,585.12 to ₹1,599.40 (+0.90%).

We pair that ₹1,599.40 daily closing floor with a strict event trigger: exit all 15 shares immediately if any of the four OAI/WL formulation sites escalates to a USFDA Import Alert or if MDL 2724 triggers a material adverse cash judgment, recognizing overnight gap risk in a cash-equity-only stock excluded from NSE F&O. And for your marginal ₹1,00,000 cash unit from the ₹14,20,949.94 Zerodha cash pool, we keep 100% in liquid cash while Zydus Lifesciences waits for a dip into its ₹1,167.24–₹1,215.29 buy zone and Lupin repairs below its 200-day average.

Think of this dossier as two distinct documents woven together. Chapters 1 through 6 are strictly price-blind—now patched with our Pass 1 forensics on Lannett, Seymour OAI, Pen-G's MIP sunset, Section 232 tariffs, and MDL 2724—locking our business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL with a KPI WATCH. Chapters 7 through 9 then open the live November 25 valuation and technical tape to render an unbiased, anti-hedging decision. Let's begin in Puducherry in 1986.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: The November 2026 refresh confirms why two-pass underwriting matters: a tighter Stage 2 VCP chart lets us hold 15 shares and ratchet our stop upward from ₹1,585.12 to ₹1,599.40, while four formulation FDA backlogs, Pen-G's Jan 2027 MIP cliff, and ₹1,850.00 base fair value keep new capital firmly REJECTED.
